seoTitle: UTM Link Builder for Campaign Tracking
metaDescription: Add source, medium and campaign parameters to a website or Google Play link.
intro: Add source, medium and campaign parameters to a website or Google Play link.
about: UTM parameters label a visit so analytics tools can attribute it to a campaign. Use consistent source, medium and campaign names across all links for the same initiative.
example: For a launch email, use source newsletter, medium email and campaign spring-launch. Copy the generated URL and open it once before publishing.

faqs.question: Where do I see campaign traffic?
faqs.answer: Look for acquisition or campaign reporting in the analytics system configured on your destination site. The link builder creates the URL.
